disclosure: Real built frontend in Chromium; simulated account, ChatGPT HTTP/SSE, speech recognition and speech synthesis. No real account login, model inference, microphone or speaker validation.

checks.name: signed-out entry and simulated account login
checks.detail: No microphone or model request before sign-in; OAuth popup completion tested only at local fixture boundary.

checks.name: explicit cloud speech consent
checks.detail: Recognition remains off before explicit consent, then listens.

checks.name: voice question, response and playback phases
checks.detail: Observed real application HTTP request and actual simulated utterance playback-start event, then resumed listening.

checks.name: typed fallback continues voice conversation
checks.detail: The next /api/chat request includes the prior voice turn and assistant reply.

checks.name: barge-in cancels stream and prevents stale history
checks.detail: Slow old stream closed; delayed tail never reached reply or subsequent history.

checks.name: explicit close ends foreground dialogue
checks.detail: Recognition and TTS stopped, HTTP stream aborted, and late output did not resurrect the exchange.

checks.name: unsupported speech browser text fallback
checks.detail: Ordinary text uses direct /api/chat without recognition or task creation.

checks.name: truncated SSE reports error and typed retry recovers
checks.detail: EOF without a terminal event becomes an explicit error, and a new typed turn completes normally.

checks.name: account error action and typed recovery
checks.detail: Simulated authentication error is readable, links to settings, and a subsequent valid fixture request recovers.

checks.name: microphone denial preserves text dialogue
checks.detail: Simulated browser permission failure is visible; typed text still sends a direct chat request.
